items.text: (1/2) As a Veteran, I know how difficult it can be to secure medical appointments to begin treatment at the VA. Reports that the VA isn’t prioritizing our Veterans’ time are unacceptable and need to change.

(2/2) My bill, the Same-Day Scheduling Act, ensures Vets who request care are able to schedule an appointment during that phone call so their treatment isn’t further delayed, and I’m proud to partner w/ @RepCarbajal @RepBrianMast and @RepMMM to get Vets the care they deserve.

I believe our Veterans deserve the best care possible, and they shouldn't have to wait to schedule treatment. My bill, the VA Same-Day Scheduling Act, eliminates wait times for Veterans scheduling appointments over the phone, and I'm very grateful for @RepGolden's support.
